title: India's LPG Subsidy at Risk if eKYC Not Done by June 30
summary: The Indian government has set a deadline of June 30 for citizens to complete the electronic Know Your Customer (eKYC) process, which is required for LPG connections. Failure to do so may result in the suspension of gas subsidies for over 2.50 lakh consumers in Bhopal. The move aims to curb black marketing and ensure that only genuine customers receive benefits.
summary_points: The Indian government has set a deadline of June 30 for citizens to complete eKYC for LPG connections.
Failure to do so may result in the suspension of gas subsidies for over 2.50 lakh consumers in Bhopal.
The move aims to curb black marketing and ensure that only genuine customers receive benefits.
The eKYC process is required for all new and existing LPG connections.
Citizens have until June 30 to complete the eKYC process online or at designated centers.
